method.gate: Every shape/block: nearest-rank p95 of each candidate read's Q1+Q2 <=21 ms under 30 ms (>=30% headroom). Baseline ratios are informative only.
method.queryBoundary: Client query dispatch to resolved response, including local loopback and pg JSON decoding; excludes metadata-only baseline query, GET and calculation.
method.baseline: Unmodified withDatasetRead, three SQL calls; time only its two effective_rights calls. Baseline-first precedes candidate SQL installation.
method.candidate: Actual withModelArtifacts, two authorize_model_read calls; freshly published matching SQL/envelope pins, no prototype orchestration.
method.cache: Warm/unflushed OS, file and database caches, existing restricted LOGIN; no cold-cache claim.

qualification: LOCAL-FIXTURE ONLY. Hosted RTT/Neon wake/region (#220) unmeasured; no #167 serving or #168 capacity claim.
limitations: Full read time and trivial byte-length calculation are informational; no parsing/context/projection workload is claimed.
Query/crypto observation adds instrumentation overhead to both arms. Server work/locks are qualified separately by CI behavior receipts, outside this timing loop.
All samples, including failures and slow blocks, are retained; failed gates are never silently filtered or relaxed.
database: PostgreSQL 18.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
